description: List the vulnerabilities in a given manifest, one entry per CVE and affected package, most severe first. Returns a page of results (see limit/offset) with the total count; long text fields are left out unless include_details is true.

fixable_only.description: Only return vulnerabilities that have a fixed version (optional, default false)

include_details.description: Include description, CVSS, URLs, advisories and data source for each entry (optional, default false; makes the response much larger)

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (optional, default 100, maximum 500)

manifest_name.description: Name of the manifest to list vulnerabilities from

min_severity.description: Minimum severity to include: Critical, High, Medium, Low, Negligible (optional; by default every severity, including unclassified ones, is returned)

namespace.description: Namespace of the manifest (optional, defaults to the namespace in the endpoint's URL)

offset.description: Number of entries to skip; pass the previous response's next_offset to get the next page (optional, default 0)

name: list_vulnerabilities_in_manifest

description: Discover available vulnerability manifests at image and workload levels. Kubescape stores them in its own namespace (usually kubescape).

continue.description: Optional Kubernetes continuation token for pagination

level.description: Type of vulnerability manifests to list

namespace.description: Namespace to list (optional, defaults to the namespace in the endpoint's URL)

name: list_vulnerability_manifests

description: List all vulnerability matches for a given CVE in a given manifest

cve_id.description: ID of the CVE to list matches for

manifest_name.description: Name of the manifest to list vulnerabilities from

namespace.description: Namespace of the manifest (optional, defaults to the namespace in the endpoint's URL)

name: list_vulnerability_matches_for_cve
